# The Generative Horizon

Archival repository for a Hermes Labs Zenodo preprint. Read the paper
at https://hermes-labs.ai/research/the-generative-horizon or cite the DOI directly.

## What this is

For language-model agents, language is simultaneously an object of interpretation and a medium of generation. This paper calls that situated condition the generative horizon and develops recursive interpretive conditioning for cases in which one output is retained as context, memory, policy, evidence, or authorization and thereby changes the conditions of later interpretation and action. It does not attribute human historical consciousness, an inner observer, privileged access, or phenomenal awareness to a language model.

## Evidence boundary

Mechanistic evidence and model-generated reports are treated as representations whose evidential status must be established rather than assumed. The paper does not attribute an inner observer, privileged access, or phenomenal awareness to a language model.

Not peer reviewed. Deposited on Zenodo, which assigns a DOI without refereeing.

## Not affiliated

Hermes Labs is not affiliated with NousResearch, Teknium, the Nous-Hermes LLM
line, or the unrelated `hermes-agent` project.
